_comment_baseUrl: baseUrl is NOT read from here — it MUST be set via the BASE_URL environment
variable in your .env file. See playwright.config.ts for details.
_comment_execution: Execution visibility — controls whether the browser shows on screen:
"headless": false  →  Visible (Headed) mode — watch tests run in real time
"headless": true   →  Background (Headless) mode — runs silently, no UI
_comment_staff: Staff names for patient Select2 interactions. Also available in config/patient-scenarios/*.scenario.json (_config.staff) for per-scenario overrides.

_comment_targetPatientIdentifier: targetPatientIdentifier — the Patient ID searched on the Patients list page
before creating/viewing appointments. This is the SINGLE source of truth used
by every appointment test — do NOT duplicate it in scenario files.
_comment_visitType: visitType — the appointment/visit type used by EVERY appointment test.
This is the SINGLE source of truth (like targetPatientIdentifier) — do NOT
duplicate it in scenario files. Must be 'Treatment Nurse Visit' for the

_comment_visitId: visitId — the visit ID located in the Visits directory (list page /visits)
whose Flow Sheet form is filled out by tests/flow-sheet.spec.ts. The test
finds the row in the Visits list, clicks the edit icon under the Actions
column, opens the Flow Sheet tab, fills every section, and saves.
The visit must be of type 'Treatment Nurse Visit' for the Flow Sheet to apply.
visitId — the visit ID located in the Visits directory (list page /visits)
whose Patient Assessment form is filled out by tests/patient-assessment.spec.ts.
The test finds the row in the Visits list, clicks the edit icon under the Actions
column, then opens the Patient Assessment form (load/visit-form/{id}/patient-assessment)
fills it, and saves. Like flowSheet.visitId, this is the SINGLE source of truth —
do NOT duplicate the visit ID in scenario files.
The visit must be of type 'Treatment Nurse Visit' for the form to apply.
visitId — the visit ID located in the Visits directory (list page /visits)
whose REFUSAL/DISCONTINUATION OF HEMODIALYSIS SESSION/S form is filled out by
tests/discontinuation.spec.ts. The test finds the row in the Visits list, clicks
the edit icon under the Actions column, then opens the Discontinue Of Hemodialysis
form (load/visit-form/{id}/dis-of-hemodialysis), fills it (EN + AR), and saves.
Like flowSheet.visitId / patientAssessment.visitId, this is the SINGLE source of
truth — do NOT duplicate the visit ID in scenario files.
The visit must be of type 'Treatment Nurse Visit' for the form to apply.
visitId — the visit ID located in the Visits directory (list page /visits)
whose VASCULAR ACCESS ASSESSMENT TOOL form is filled out by
tests/vascular-access.spec.ts. The test finds the row in the Visits list, clicks
the edit icon under the Actions column, then opens the Vascular Access Assessment
form (load/visit-form/{id}/vascular-access-assessment), fills it (access type,
scoring checkboxes, post-care, interventions), and saves.
Like flowSheet.visitId / patientAssessment.visitId / discontinuation.visitId, this
is the SINGLE source of truth — do NOT duplicate the visit ID in scenario files.
The visit must be of type 'Treatment Nurse Visit' for the form to apply.
visitId — the visit ID located in the Visits directory (list page /visits)
whose Respiratory Triage tab is filled out by tests/respiratory-triage.spec.ts.
The test finds the row in the Visits list, clicks the edit icon under the Actions
column, opens the Respiratory Triage tab (load/visit-form/{id}/respiratory-triage —
a LIST page), clicks 'Add New' (load/form/{patientId}/respiratory-triage?display=create
where patientId = appointment.targetPatientIdentifier), fills the checklist, and saves
(?display=create → ?display=index). Like the other visitId keys, this is the SINGLE
source of truth — do NOT duplicate the visit ID in scenario files.
The visit must be of type 'Treatment Nurse Visit' for the tab to apply.

_comment_appointmentConfig: Appointment test parameters (defaultDurationMinutes, etc.) live in the _config block of each file in config/appointment-scenarios/, and form fields (date, time, notes, etc.) in _fields. targetPatientIdentifier and visitType are the exceptions — they are defined above under "appointment" so all tests share one consistent value.
